context_for_next_testing_agent: All tests pass. Backend API and frontend UI both working correctly. The Playwright/React 19 state update issue from previous iterations was resolved - dispatchEvent with 'input' event successfully triggers React state changes. The disabled button styling fix (disabled:opacity-40 disabled:bg-honey/50) is visually effective. PWA assets (manifest.json, sw.js, icons) all accessible. Auth flow redirects working correctly.
rca_of_issue: Previous iterations reported Playwright could not trigger React state updates. This was resolved by using dispatchEvent with Event('input', {bubbles: true}) instead of Event('change'). The disabled button styling issue was fixed by main agent changing from disabled:opacity-50 to disabled:opacity-40 disabled:bg-honey/50, which provides clear visual feedback.
